objective: Execute one complete OCLOB lifecycle in which participants create verifiable secret shares before coordinator contact, seven isolated MPC nodes agree on matching output, and participant-authorized settlement capabilities produce a Maker reservation followed by atomic Taker reservation and DvP on a five-validator non-EVM DeFMI Avalanche L1.
official_upstream_exception: MP-SPDZ compile.py is permitted only as the official compiler invoked through the Rust compiler adapter.

privacy.participant_edge: The complete SecretOrder exists only inside its participant process before Pedersen-verifiable sharing.
privacy.coordinator: The coordinator receives commitments, certificates and signed public MPC outputs, but no complete order or set of seven shares.
privacy.settlement_gateway: The gateway alone opens the participant-signed fixed-size settlement capability and verifies that its values are the constant terms committed into the MPC shares.
opened_after_match: canonical transaction identifiers and state roots
forbidden: all seven shares in one MPC node
private order fields in logs or public artifact

canonical_flow: Maker capability and DeKYX presentation are verified by the settlement gateway
seven malicious-shamir parties agree that the Maker rests without a fill
Maker maximum inventory reservation is finalized on DeFMI before admission
seven malicious-shamir parties agree on the crossing Taker result
Taker maximum cash reservation and all DvP legs finalize in one canonical transition
all five validators return the same state root
the identical transition is rejected as a replay
a restarted validator recovers the accepted state root

required: both participants receive signed admission receipts from all seven MPC nodes
all seven nodes agree on the same program digest, artifact digest and public result for both rounds
the Maker reservation finalizes before its order can be used by the Taker round
the Taker fills 40 lots at price 100 with no post-match signature
amount and price evidence in zkPI are threshold generated
Taker reservation and DvP finalize atomically
five validator roots agree before and after one validator restart
receipt-chain verification and replay refusal pass
reject_if: the contract SHA-256 does not match the preregistered manifest
any node is omitted or reports a different result
settlement values are not bound to the VSS commitments
Maker admission occurs before canonical reservation
Taker reserve exists without the corresponding DvP
the artifact claims independent operators, WAN evidence, HSM custody, threshold settlement decryption or account-free notes

non_claims: Seven MPC containers and five AvalancheGo validators on one host are not independent-operator or WAN evidence.
The settlement capability is opened by one laboratory gateway; threshold decryption remains a production cutover.
Transition and DeFMI approval keys are deterministic laboratory keys, not HSM-backed operator custody.
Canonical DeFMI state uses commitment accounts and a reservation root rather than account-free product notes.
One functional scenario is not throughput, security-attack or economic-effect evidence.
